purpose: replace transient lift success with stable terminal grasp and training-quality gates

interpretation.legacy_success: trajectory once stayed above 10 cm for 30 steps
interpretation.stable_physics_success: legacy gate plus the complete final hold remains lifted, contacted, and nearly stationary
interpretation.transport_quality_success: stable physics plus object pose changes little relative to the palm after leaving the table
interpretation.training_eligible: transport quality plus the hand-specific anatomical gate
